population.rule: Every (day, activity) row in staging: 1 Oct 2026 onward, only fully ended UTC days.

assumptions.chosen: PRs opened, PRs merged, commits (GitHub Search API total_count)
assumptions.detail: user: metric 4 is GitHub PRs / commits; docs/metrics.md names the Search API `is:pr created:<day>`

assumptions.chosen: UTC day, first to last second
assumptions.detail: config.py: all days in this study are UTC days

assumptions.chosen: same activity, same weekday 7 calendar days earlier (date join); NULL when either day is missing
assumptions.detail: user, 20 Nov: add the previous Thursdays as context and highlight the drop; the headline compares with the Thursday before the same way

activity_label.description: PRs opened, PRs merged or Commits.

activity_count.description: How many on the day. NULL when unavailable, never zero.
activity_count.null_rule: NULL when unavailable, never zero. Never add across activities.

is_available.description: True when the day's count is complete.

is_release_day.description: True on GTA 6's release day (var github_release_day).

days_from_release.description: Days after release day (negative before it).

observed_at.description: When the count was asked for (UTC).

prior_week_count.description: The same activity on the same weekday a week earlier. NULL when that day was not counted.
prior_week_count.null_rule: NULL when the week-earlier day has no count.

wow_pct_change.description: The day against the same weekday a week earlier, in percent.
wow_pct_change.null_rule: NULL unless both days have a count and the week before is above zero.

fct_github_daily.content:
name: fct_github_daily
description: 'Metric 4: GitHub activity per UTC day, one row per day per activity. Population: Every (day, activity) row in staging: 1 Oct 2026 onward, only fully ended UTC days.'
model: ref('fct_github_daily')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: activity_date
dimensions:
  - name: activity_date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: UTC day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: activity
    type: categorical
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: weekday_name
    type: categorical
    description: Day of the week.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: is_release_day
    type: categorical
    description: True on GTA 6's release day (var github_release_day).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: days_from_release
    type: categorical
    description: Days after release day (negative before it).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
measures:
  - name: activity_count
    agg: sum
    expr: activity_count
    description: How many on the day. NULL when unavailable, never zero.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: NULL when unavailable, never zero. Never add across activities.
  - name: prior_week_count
    agg: max
    expr: prior_week_count
    description: The same activity on the same weekday a week earlier. NULL when that day was not counted.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: NULL when the week-earlier day has no count.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: wow_pct_change
    agg: max
    expr: wow_pct_change
    description: The day against the same weekday a week earlier, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL unless both days have a count and the week before is above zero.
          additivity: non_additive
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: 'Every (day, activity) row in staging: 1 Oct 2026 onward, only fully ended UTC days.'
        parent:
          model: stg_github__daily_counts
          key:
            activity_date: activity_date
            activity: activity
      assumptions:
        - decision: What 'GitHub activity' counts
          chosen: PRs opened, PRs merged, commits (GitHub Search API total_count)
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: metric 4 is GitHub PRs / commits; docs/metrics.md names the Search API `is:pr created:<day>`'
          column: activity
        - decision: Day boundary
          chosen: UTC day, first to last second
          evidence: contract
          detail: 'config.py: all days in this study are UTC days'
          column: activity_date
        - decision: Week-on-week pairing
          chosen: same activity, same weekday 7 calendar days earlier (date join); NULL when either day is missing
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user, 20 Nov: add the previous Thursdays as context and highlight the drop; the headline compares with the Thursday before the same way'
          column: wow_pct_change
fct_github_daily.reason: fct_github_daily already has a semantic model ('fct_github_daily' in models/marts/fct_github_daily_semantic.yml); an authored definition is not overwritten or duplicated
notes: activity_date: its type could not be read, so it is given day granularity, which a date or a timestamp both support
not derived (role key or attribute, which a semantic model has no element for): github_day_key, activity_label, is_available, observed_at
metrics are not derived: a measure is what a column holds, a metric is a business definition, and that stays the author's
limitations: the grain is composite (activity_date, activity), so no single column is the primary entity and none was guessed. MetricFlow needs one for any dimension or measure: add `primary_entity: <name>` naming what one row is, then pass the definition to `semantic plan --definitions-file`
